question: Can candidate-directed reverse search obtain useful valid paths for currently unmeasured proposed/near-tie candidates at a small, explicit fixed extra-work cap, and then support calibrated current-price scoring?
evidence_summary: Complete tracing covers112704leaf-side requests with26900measured andnooutput/cacheomissions. Both sides known for557of56352candidate-leaf events; only36of704proposed leaves both-known. Intrinsic exact coverage alone previously did not improve QoR, so price-aware path information is a distinct hypothesis, not more identical queries.
prototype: A bounded candidate-targeted path search with explicit physical-edge delays and optional nonnegative price toll in the same seconds unit. A geometric heuristic orders work only; it must never certify optimal distance. Return an actual directed path as an upper-bound estimate and claim exactness only from a valid zero-heuristic/frontier lower-bound certificate. Keep original physical distance caches unchanged; current-price queries are scoped to one immutable plan-price snapshot.
unit_input: Random small directed weighted graphs including zero cycles, parallel edges, non-admissible heuristics, resource stops and repeated searches. Independent Floyd checks all claimed exact values; every returned path and physical/priced cost must be valid and upper-bound the optimum.
native_initial_case: eltwise_layer seed11 Hybrid-O P0 W100 count2 Tf, original SCC/DP/guide update policy; release/freeze flags0.
native_design: Default-off C exact Tf. Query-only controls Q0(no spatial ordering, zero toll), Qh(spatial ordering, zero toll), Qp(spatial ordering, bounded current-price toll) have identical maximum new-work/storage settings and cannot change costs/guides in this stage. Native route/table/guide/legacy-query equivalence and actual RRG path/weight validation required before any scoring pilot. New query expansions, labels/stops, coverage/reliability and planning/full-process cost explicitly recorded.
allocation: VPR-selected refreshes only; prioritize actual remaining targets by criticality and candidate-ranking uncertainty. Initially at most2leaves/net and2candidate entries/leaf (base proposal plus near-rank/diverse alternative), shared256newexpansions/refresh, sparse label cap16384, heap cap65536. Skip already fully known/trivial source work. These are prototype resource settings, not research caps; change only with an evidence-linked new registration.
budget_qualification: Do not enlarge legacy delay_budget4096 or conceal new query work. The additional fixed candidate-work cap must be compared with equal-cap non-directed and delay-only controls; a coverage gain is not a QoR gain or speedup.
later_scoring: If native directed-path validity and useful coverage pass, separately register a bounded, confidence-weighted current-price score with same-unit calibrated unknown estimates, geometric fallback/diversity, prior-cost reevaluation/hysteresis and native Tdel/STA untouched. Do not directly penalize a single congested canonical witness as though it were minimum congestion among equal-delay paths.
